newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: More gains seen for Sri Lanka stocks.
newsitem.headline: More gains seen for Sri Lanka stocks.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were expected to rack up further gains on Tuesday, shrugging off heavy losses on Wall Street, brokers said.
"The general feeling is that if you don't buy now you will miss out," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena, manager international sales at Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
"There is a lot of buying interest among investors as well as speculators," he said.
On Monday, the Colombo all share index rose by 8.6 points to close at 796. Turnover was 74 million rupees.
Brokers said said Monday's sharp drop on Wall Street was unlikely to affect the local market as it was largely isolated from global developments.
They said investors were confident that the market would not drop below current levels. Speculators were eyeing short-term gains which were also present in the market.
"We are seeing some profit-taking also, though the market is unlikely to come down any time soon," said Dimuthu Abeysekera of Allied Phillips Securities.
Brokers said a combination of good second half corporate results, falling interest rates and domestic political stability had helped buoy the Colombo market.
